rationale: Revision fa93cded4604868420c92628a6b0193357e8c4d1 addresses all four round-1 revise findings with regression tests — receipts key on declared dependencies and are withheld if a run changes them, any command that modifies tracked files fails with its own log, a join timeout re-evaluates via retry instead of running the key unlocked, and check:fast again covers the system tier — with check:fast (618 fast + 177 system tests) and the push-hook e2e passing at commit and push.
